_doc: docs/automation-foundations.md. The MONEY SET (contract 8.1). Every auto path calls scripts/lib/is-money.mjs isMoney() immediately before acting; a hit anywhere (a changed path, an added OR removed line of any changed file incl. .md/.json, a migration statement) = refuse with `money set: <name>`. paths: globs, case-insensitive, `**` any depth, `*` within one segment. Every other list: NAMES matched as whole identifiers (neighbours must not be [A-Za-z0-9_]; `-` is a boundary), case-sensitive in paths and changed lines, case-insensitive in migration statements (Postgres folds unquoted identifiers); `*` inside a name = [A-Za-z0-9_]*. keys may also hold {regex, why}: the regex must be anchored ^...$ and is tested against each identifier token of a line. Names only: never a secret value. Guard path: changing this file is an owner-merged guard change.

keys.why: a Stripe price id (price_ + 14 or more alphanumerics with at least one digit); price_currency / price_display do not match
